metadata_caption: Backstory ::: Today my wife has reached her third trimester! ❤️🎉 She has been working so hard to grow this baby, and so I have been making life as fun and stress-free for her so that this baby grows healthy and happy. On my way home, I stopped and bought these shoes for the baby because these are the shoes that Kay wears the most. Now when the baby is old enough to wear some little shoes, they can match each other! Kay is always so thankful for everything I do, and is such a beautiful and pure person. I love being able to surprise her with things like this, and love being able to experience this pregnancy journey with her, even though I am often working long hours. My search continues for a remote job so that I can be home to watch our baby grow and be a bigger part of her life. In the mean time though, I will continue to help Kay in any way that I can to get this baby grown! 😂❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant
